description: This Java source file defines the SubUpdater class, which manages local subscriptions in a publish-subscribe system using Akka actors. It handles subscription requests, unsubscriptions, distributed data operations, and acknowledgments related to topic subscriptions within a clustered environment.

classes.name: SubUpdater
classes.description: Manages local subscriptions, requests distributed data updates, handles acknowledgments, and coordinates subscription state within an Akka actor in a clustered publish-subscribe system.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates and returns a Props object to instantiate the SubUpdater actor with given configuration, subscriber, and distributed data access.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Handles subscription requests, updates in the local subscription state, and sets up monitoring of subscribers.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Handles unsubscription requests and updates the local subscription state, including removing actor monitoring.

methods.name: ddataOpSuccess
methods.description: Handles successful distributed data operations, sends acknowledgments, and resets change tracking flags.

methods.name: tick
methods.description: Performs periodic distributed data operations, forcing updates if necessary, and manages acknowledgment state.

methods.name: flushSubAcks
methods.description: Sends subscription acknowledgment messages to registered senders.

methods.name: performDDataOp
methods.description: Performs distributed data read/write operations based on whether there are local subscription changes and whether a forced update is required.
